Their tasks
• Process responsibility for the person-centered care and care of our residents
• Day guidance with responsibility for a smooth running of the care everyday
• Active participation in project and specialist groups of the KZU
• Professional recognition and action in complex, rapidly changing situations
• Interprofessional cooperation, in particular with the fields of therapy and medical service
• Enjoyment of medical technical procedures and their professional execution

Your profile
• Completed training as a nurse HF/FH or a foreign diploma recognised by the SRC
• Experience in medical engineering operations is advantageous
• Service-oriented and person-centered action and work
• Knowledge of Kinaesthetics, Integrative Validation and Basal Stimulation
• Safe handling of digital care documentation
• Responsibility, independence and organisational skills in everyday care

We offer more than just a job: You can look forward to attractive and up-to-date employment conditions as well as a variety of benefits – for example, two additional days off per year or the promotion of your internal career opportunities. You can expect a varied working environment at a modern and future-oriented employer. Our locations are easily accessible by public transport. In addition, parking facilities are available directly on the site. Own nurseries as well as a restaurant in Bassersdorf and Embrach are an additional plus in everyday work.
